page.layout: One printed page: a printer's ornamental band at the top, then the title PROOEMIUM. at full width, then one column of running text, with a historiated initial S at its start. No margin notes. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: PROOEMIUM.
main_text.p: SEX anni sunt cum in Evangelia Matthæi & Marci Commentarium edidi, qui subjectam verbis sententiam, eamque litteræ consentaneam aperte declararet. Ad hujus à me confectionem adhibitum & quod evolvendus iis, quæ Patres Ecclesiæ reliquerunt, monumentis animadverti, & quod observavi perlegendis & diligenter expendendis multis & variis scriptoribus tam antiquis, quam neotericis, & quod mihimet ipsi prudentiæ ac cognitionis impertivit Deus optimus. Erat appendicis loco, quod novi fœderis intelligentiam præbet non contemnendam, comprehensi animo ritus Hebræorum & idiomata, in quibus ego natus, institutus, & educatus sum. Id temporis

page.notes: The initial S is a decorated woodcut letter; the first word is joined to it as SEX. The "EX" of the first word is set in capitals. The running head "Prooemium." at the top is faint and partly show-through, so it is uncertain. No page number is visible. The first line's "cùm" is read as "cum" and may carry an accent. The line "declararet." has a faint mark that may be a press flaw.
